FQB.Config.Title: Quest Board
FQB.Settings.ShowJournalButtonHint: Show the Quest Boards button at the top of the Journal sidebar.
FQB.Settings.PlayersCanBrowseHint: Let players open a player-visible board themselves. Off means a board is only ever seen when you show it to them.
FQB.Settings.DefaultBoardStyleHint: The surface a newly created board starts with.
FQB.Settings.DefaultTemplateHint: What a newly pinned notice is printed on.
FQB.Settings.ConfigMenu.Name: Quest Board
FQB.Settings.ConfigMenu.Label: Configure
FQB.Settings.ConfigMenu.Hint: Preferences for the notice boards. The boards themselves are built from the Quest Boards button in the Journal sidebar.
FQB.Library.Title: Quest Boards
FQB.Library.EmptyGM: No boards yet. Create one to get started.
FQB.Library.EmptyPlayer: There are no boards to look at right now.
FQB.Library.DeleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and every notice on it? This cannot be undone.
FQB.Library.HideTooltip: Close the board on everyone's screen
FQB.Library.UnrevealedTooltip: Notices the players cannot see yet
FQB.Board.Title: Notice Board
FQB.Board.Missing: This board is no longer here.
FQB.Board.EmptyGM: Nothing pinned up yet. Add a notice.
FQB.Board.ArrangeHint: Drag a notice to move it. Scroll the wheel over one to tilt it. Click Arrange again when you are done.
FQB.Board.AddNoticeTooltip: Pin a new notice to this board
FQB.Board.ShowTooltip: Open this board on every player's screen
FQB.Board.TakeDownTooltip: Close this board on everyone's screen
FQB.Board.DragTooltip: Drag to move, wheel to tilt
FQB.Board.CloseTooltip: Close the board on your screen
FQB.Editor.Title: Edit Board
FQB.Editor.SubtitlePlaceholder: Posted by order of the Reeve
FQB.Editor.SubtitleHint: The line on the board's header. Optional.
FQB.Editor.StyleHint: The board the notices hang on. The illustrated boards keep their notices on the panel inside the frame.
FQB.Editor.BackgroundHint: Optional. Your own art, filling the whole surface in place of the style above — notices can then be pinned anywhere on it.
FQB.Editor.PlayerVisibleHint: You can still show a board to the table with this off — this only controls whether players can open it themselves.
FQB.Editor.NoNotices: Nothing is pinned to this board yet.
FQB.Editor.LinkedTooltip: Linked to a journal entry or quest
FQB.NoticeEditor.Title: Edit Notice
FQB.NoticeEditor.TitlePlaceholder: WANTED: The Ogre of Coldbeck Ford
FQB.NoticeEditor.TextHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. The board shows the first one; the close-up shows all of it.
FQB.NoticeEditor.ImageHint: Optional. A portrait for a wanted poster, a sketch for a rumour.
FQB.NoticeEditor.RewardPlaceholder: 100 gold, paid at the Reeve's door
FQB.NoticeEditor.LinkEmpty: Drop a journal entry or quest here
FQB.NoticeEditor.LinkHint: Optional. Drag anything with a UUID onto this field — a journal entry, one of its pages, or a quest from another module. This module only opens it; whatever you already use to track quests keeps tracking it.
FQB.NoticeEditor.RotationHint: Nothing on a real board hangs straight. You can also tilt a notice with the wheel while arranging the board.
FQB.NoticeEditor.HiddenHint: Pinned up but not yet revealed. Players do not receive it at all until you reveal it.
FQB.Notice.Title: Notice
FQB.Notice.Gone: This notice is no longer on the board.
FQB.Notice.BrokenLink: The linked entry no longer exists.
FQB.Notify.NameRequired: Give the board a name before saving.
FQB.Notify.ShowingHiddenBoard: Showing a board the players cannot browse on their own. They will see it until you take it down.
FQB.Notify.MissingLink: That notice links to something that no longer exists.
FQB.Notify.UnopenableLink: That notice links to something with nothing to open.
